banking_law: This bank was written and hash-committed (its sha256 recorded in receipt.json provenance_pins.vocab_bank) BEFORE any judgment run and before judgement.json existed. The P2 lesson (skeleton_movie_20260919: the size probe's judgment vocabulary must be banked too) is honored: the size/proportion category is banked alongside gait, not added after seeing reports.
scorer_contract: vocab_align(report, bank) in tools/science_funnel/walk_movie.py: for each category, a stem counts as HIT when the case-folded report contains it as a word prefix (regex r'\b' + stem, so 'walk' hits walk/walking/walked, 'collaps' hits collapse/collapsing). Per-category: hits, ratio = hits/len(stems), matched stems listed. The scorer reads NOTHING outside this bank; it is pure string arithmetic, deterministic, no model.

gait.why: the movie shows a WALK trace: limb phases, stepping; the eye must read motion of legs/limbs

body_plan.why: the walker is a quadruped (pelvis trunk + two hind + two fore legs): the eye must read a four-legged / animal-like body plan

size_proportion.why: the P2 lesson: size/proportion vocabulary banked BEFORE the judgment so a size miss (oversized/undersized/proportion reading) can never be excused by an unbanked term

posture_collapse.why: the honest current trace ends in a collapse (the R shoulder sinking, the body tipping); predicted the eye reads falling/slumping but honestly uncertain

segment_build.why: the walker is rendered as boxes/capsules per Table-1 segment: blocky build terms

ground_contact.why: a walk is a ground contact phenomenon: feet/paws on a floor
